## Spectral Analysis

**Key experimental peaks to explain:**
- 822 / 839 cm⁻¹ (strong doublet) — aromatic C-H out-of-plane or ring modes
- 1075 cm⁻¹ — C-C / C-O stretch or ring breathing
- 1268 cm⁻¹ — C-O-C stretch or C-N stretch
- 1600 cm⁻¹ — aromatic C=C stretch (very characteristic of phenyl ring)
- 1686 cm⁻¹ — C=O stretch (conjugated carbonyl, consistent with aryl ketone or aldehyde)
- 3081 cm⁻¹ — aromatic C-H stretch
- 2930 cm⁻¹ — aliphatic C-H stretch (CH₃ group)
- 636, 679, 720 cm⁻¹ — ring deformation / halogen-sensitive modes
- 1159 cm⁻¹ — C-F stretch or C-O stretch
- 1509 cm⁻¹ — aromatic ring mode

**Structural reasoning:**

The spectrum strongly suggests a **para-substituted aromatic ring** based on:
- The 822/839 cm⁻¹ doublet (para-substituted ring C-H oop bending typically ~820-850 cm⁻¹)
- 1600 cm⁻¹ aromatic C=C (strong, ring mode)
- 3081 cm⁻¹ aromatic C-H
- 1509 cm⁻¹ ring mode

The **1686 cm⁻¹ peak** is highly diagnostic — this is a conjugated C=O stretch consistent with an aryl ketone (acetophenone-type) or aryl aldehyde. A free acetyl C=O on a benzene ring typically appears ~1680-1700 cm⁻¹ in Raman.

The **2930 cm⁻¹** peak indicates a CH₃ group (methyl C-H stretch).

**Candidate evaluation:**

- **Candidate 1: CC(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1** — 4-fluoroacetophenone. Para-substituted benzene ring with acetyl (C=O ~1686 cm⁻¹ fits well), CH₃ (~2930 cm⁻¹), aromatic C-H (3081 cm⁻¹), ring modes at 1600 cm⁻¹. The C-F stretch would appear ~1159 cm⁻¹ (matches peak 8 very well). Para substitution explains the 822/839 cm⁻¹ doublet. Ring breathing ~1075 cm⁻¹ fits. The 1268 cm⁻¹ could be C-F related or C-C stretch. This candidate matches nearly every significant peak.

- **Candidate 3: CC(=O)c1ccc(Cl)nc1** — has a pyridine ring (N replaces CH), which would shift ring modes notably. Less consistent with the clean aromatic pattern seen.

- **Candidate 4: CC(=O)c1cccc(O)c1** — meta-hydroxy acetophenone; meta substitution pattern would give different oop bending frequencies.

4-Fluoroacetophenone (candidate 1) provides the best overall match: the C=O at 1686 cm⁻¹, aromatic ring at 1600 cm⁻¹, C-F stretch at ~1159 cm⁻¹, para-ring oop bending at 822/839 cm⁻¹, CH₃ at 2930 cm⁻¹, and aromatic C-H at 3081 cm⁻¹ all align with the experimental data.

---

SELECTED_INDEX: 1
CONFIDENCE: 0.82
EXPLANATION: The experimental spectrum is dominated by a para-substituted aromatic ketone signature. The 1686 cm⁻¹ peak matches the conjugated C=O stretch of an aryl acetyl group; 1600 cm⁻¹ and 3081 cm⁻¹ confirm the aromatic ring; 2930 cm⁻¹ fits the CH₃ group; 1159 cm⁻¹ aligns with the C-F stretching mode of a para-fluorine substituent; and the 822/839 cm⁻¹ doublet is consistent with para-disubstituted benzene out-of-plane C-H bending. Together these features uniquely support 4-fluoroacetophenone (CC(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1).
